title: Intelligent Species Need More Than Different Ears
lesson: A different species isn't a human in a costume. Its biology (what it senses, how long it lives, how its families work, what its body needs, how it talks) decides what it builds and how it understands the world.

voice.direction: The same lab host, warmer and more wondering for a people rather than a monster. The hook is a friendly challenge. 'Now the lazy version' is a knowing grin. 'Spot the difference. There isn't one.' lands dry. The traits are crisp. 'The Fenn speak in light' is a quiet wonder; 'Ghost lights on the lake' is the reveal. The comment ask is curious.

lines.text: Giving elves pointy ears doesn't make them a distinct civilization.
Meet the Fenn. They stacked these stones.
Now the lazy version: humans, with different ears.
A hundred years later: same houses, same barns, same bell tower.
Spot the difference. There isn't one.
Biology should change the build. Four traits are easy. The fifth is the twist.
One: senses. They see in the dark, so they live underground.
Two: lifespan. Four hundred years, so they build in stone.
Three: family. One clan, one great hall.
Four: needs. Their skin must stay wet, so they build on the lake.
Run it again. Nothing here looks human now.
Rule five? How they talk. The Fenn speak in light.
So their hall has no walls, only windows.
And from the human valley? Ghost lights on the lake.
Pointy ears are a costume. Biology is a blueprint.
Invent one biological trait that would completely change a species' society. Comment it.
Part 28 of 50. Follow for part 29: someone on the Isle never dies.

shots.purpose: Close EP27's loop (who stacked the stones?) and stop the scroll on the claim.
shots.visual: At a Fenn's eye height in golden light: the small teal Fenn who stacked EP27's cairn, lifting a stone over its head; big night eyes, fin frills, glowing spots. POINTY EARS / AREN'T A / CIVILIZATION. Then the field card: FENN · INTELLIGENT SPECIES · BUILT: these stones.
shots.camera: Low and close (el 5, dist 17, fov 24), a slow push; the last 11 s return to this pose.
shots.transition: Reset wipe into the lazy version.
shots.music: Folk: kalimba, ocarina theme, hand drums; a hit on 'civilization'.

shots.purpose: The lazy version, shown as a character editor: one slider moved, everything else left human.
shots.visual: A teal block wipe (RESET): the Fenn become humans with pointy ears in a copy of a human village on the east meadow. The SPECIES EDITOR: EARS slides ROUND → POINTY; EYES, LIFESPAN, FAMILY, SKIN, VOICE stay on HUMAN. HUMAN-LIKE 96 %. RUN.
shots.camera: Low at the copied village (el 6, dist 30), then the wide on 'run'.
shots.onScreenText: SPECIES EDITOR · FENN = HUMAN + EARS; HUMAN-LIKE 96%

shots.purpose: Run the lazy version: it grows exactly like a human village.
shots.visual: Whole Isle; YEAR 0→100; the Fenn copy grows (two more houses, the bell tower rings); FENN 24→40; the graph's HUMAN-LIKE line stays flat at 96.

shots.purpose: The punchline: spot the difference, there isn't one.
shots.visual: Both villages side by side from the south, pinned HUMANS and FENN: slate roofs, barns, bell towers, the same. 0 DIFFERENCES · HUMANS + EARS.

shots.purpose: Re-hook: the editor again, now with five real traits, four easy and one locked.
shots.visual: REWIND to year 0; the SPECIES EDITOR · HUMAN → FENN checklist, each row a slider still on HUMAN, row 5 locked and blinking.
Night. The SENSES slider slides; the Fenn's eyes grow huge and dark; the houses sink into the earth as turf mounds with glowing doors. HUMAN-LIKE 96→78.

layers.midground: Fenn with night eyes, turf mounds

shots.visual: Dusk. LIFESPAN slides; the mounds' walls turn to dressed stone and stand taller. 78→60.
Day. FAMILY slides; the houses, tower and road give way, and one great round hall rises in their place. 60→42.
shots.camera: Eye height, a little higher (el 10, dist 40).

shots.visual: NEEDS slides; the Fenn's skin turns glossy teal and their ears become fins; the great hall unbuilds and rises again on stilts on the lake, and they follow. 42→22.

shots.purpose: Run the real Fenn: nothing is copied any more.
shots.visual: Whole Isle; YEAR 0→100; the hall on the lake; FENN 24→40; ORIGINAL · NOTHING COPIED.
shots.transition: Down to the lake at night.
shots.music: Folk at full, a stab and cymbal on 'nothing'.

shots.purpose: The locked rule: how they talk.
shots.visual: Night, on the hall's deck at a Fenn's eye height: RULE 5? HOW THEY TALK; the Fenn's spots light up; the hall's walls open into pillars and its windows flicker in travelling waves of light.
shots.camera: Eye height on the deck (el 5, dist 22).
shots.music: Twist, then glow: choir, vibraphone ripples, celesta theme.

shots.purpose: Unlock rule 5, and the payoff: how another species understands them.
shots.visual: From the human valley at night, across the island: lights flicker on the lake. HUMAN LEGEND · GHOST LIGHTS. Row 5 unlocks (VOICE · they speak in light); HUMAN-LIKE 00 %, ITS OWN PEOPLE.
shots.camera: Long lens from the valley (el 7, dist 34, fov 22).

layers.foreground: pin, unlocked card, meter, follow chip

shots.music: Glow; a big D-major hit on 'lake'.

shots.purpose: The takeaway: the full editor card.
shots.visual: The complete FENN card (BEFORE YOU INVENT A SPECIES, all five sliders on FENN) with 'Biology is a blueprint.' in serif italic.
shots.transition: Block wipe to the end card.
shots.music: Anthem; the World Engine chime as the card lands.

shots.visual: End card: logo, PART 28 / 50, title, a speech-bubble COMMENT panel.
shots.camera: Cut (under the block wipe) back to the hook pose.

graphics.title: Intelligent Species Need More Than Different Ears
graphics.with: Invent one biological trait that would change a whole society.

shots.purpose: Say the part number, ask for the follow with a reason (part 29), open the next loop.
shots.visual: The hook frame; PART 28/50; FOLLOW FOR PART 29; NEXT RUN 29 · UNDYING from a locked hourglass; behind, years race (winters flicker, the forest thins and grows back) while the Fenn stacks its stone; the hook title returns.

layers.foreground: progress bar, follow button, next-run card

shots.onScreenText: PART 28/50 · FOLLOW FOR PART 29 · NEXT RUN: UNDYING · SOMEONE NEVER DIES.
shots.music: Tease over a held A, a horn call, the engine chime on 'Follow'.

youtube.description:
Giving elves pointy ears doesn't make them a distinct civilization.

Meet the Fenn: they stacked the stones on the Isle. The lazy version is humans with different ears, and we ran it: a hundred years later, same houses, same barns, same bell tower. Spot the difference. There isn't one.

So change their biology instead. They see in the dark, so they live underground. They live four hundred years, so they build in stone. One clan shares one great hall. Their skin must stay wet, so they build on the lake. Then the twist: they speak in light, so their hall has no walls, only windows. And to the humans in the valley? Ghost lights on the lake.

Pointy ears are a costume. Biology is a blueprint.

Invent one biological trait that would completely change a species' society. Comment it.

Part 28 of 50. Follow for part 29: someone on the Isle never dies.
